item.title: RFQ 2026/48 - PEACEPLUS Roots Relationships Programme - Slieve Gullion DEA
item.description:
Advertised value: GBP 10,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-12-15T12:00:00Z
To deliver a community-led Arts, Crafts and Heritage Capacity Building Programme in the Slieve Gullion DEA, working with community groups from the Forkhill and Newtownhamilton areas. The programme should use arts, crafts, cultural heritage and creative skills development as a vehicle for building organisational capacity, increasing skills and confidence, supporting knowledge exchange, and creating opportunities for participants to learn from one another through practical activities, shared experiences and networking opportunities. The programme should celebrate and explore the rich cultural and heritage assets of the area while creating opportunities for participants from different backgrounds to connect, collaborate and develop lasting relationships. Through shared learning and creative engagement, participants will strengthen both their individual skills and the sustainability of their community organisations. This project will serve as both a community development initiative and a peacebuilding mechanism, creating sustained and meaningful contact across communities while strengthening local organisations and promoting appreciation of the area's diverse cultural heritage.
